source_annotations.description: Manual head-echo ROI labels from range-time-Doppler matched-filter products.

doppler_model: f_D = (f0/c) * (u_tx + u_rx) dot v, positive for increasing bistatic path length

trajectory_fit_weighting.description: two-stage range/Doppler fit: robust independent-weight solve for initialization, followed by linear GLS solve whitened by triangular coherent-integration overlap covariance

linearized_fit_error.covariance_model: standard linearized GLS covariance (J^T Sigma^-1 J)^-1 using finite-difference physical Jacobian and triangular coherent-integration overlap correlations within each station and observable

correlated_covariance_details.covariance_model: standard linearized GLS covariance (J^T Sigma^-1 J)^-1 using finite-difference physical Jacobian and triangular coherent-integration overlap correlations within each station and observable
correlated_covariance_details.measurement_covariance_model: range and Doppler are independent to first order; neighboring samples from the same station and observable have correlation max(0, 1 - lag_codes / coherent_codes)
